name: Classic City Shhhhh 2017
information: The registration fee is $15. There is a 40 person competitor limit. To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. EVERYONE MUST PAY, including Staff. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Fewest Moves, 3x3 with Feet, Rubik's Clock, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multiblind, Speed FMC(Unofficial), Pyraminx FMC (Unofficial), 6x6 Cube (Tentative), 7x7 Cube (Tentative).
